description: This file defines the ParagraphFormatRenderer class responsible for rendering ParagraphFormat objects into RTF format within the MigraDoc document preparation library. It includes methods to translate various paragraph formatting properties such as alignment, indentation, spacing, shading, borders, and list formatting into RTF controls.

classes.name: ParagraphFormatRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that converts a ParagraphFormat object into RTF by translating its properties into corresponding RTF controls.

methods.name: ParagraphFormatRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a DocumentObject (specifically ParagraphFormat) and an RtfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the ParagraphFormat properties into RTF commands, handling spacing, indentation, outline level, shading, font, borders, tab stops, and list info.
